lessons.trigger_condition: scheduler or update lock trusts a recorded numeric PID using kill -0 without validating the live process command line
lessons.symptom_summary: a reused PID can be mistaken for the TCG scheduler/update process, causing false running state or signalling the wrong process
lessons.fix_pattern: validate /proc/<pid>/cmdline for the exact TABLET_SCHEDULED_UPDATE.sh mode before trusting or signalling a PID, version persisted loop identity, and migrate only verified legacy scheduler processes

lessons.trigger_condition: periodic heartbeat rewrites BOOT_LOOP_STARTED_AT with the current time instead of retaining the original loop start
lessons.symptom_summary: runtime diagnostics cannot distinguish a newly started scheduler from a long-running healthy loop with a recent heartbeat
lessons.fix_pattern: capture loop start once, keep it immutable for the process lifetime, record a separate BOOT_LOOP_HEARTBEAT_AT value, and reconcile the installed scheduler after code-update runs

lessons.trigger_condition: offline fallback uses ignoreSearch=true before attempting an exact cache match for a request with query parameters
lessons.symptom_summary: a cached response for a different query can be returned even when the exact request variant is available
lessons.fix_pattern: try caches.match(request) first, use ignoreSearch=true only as a secondary fallback, and preserve the existing cache ABI and network-first behavior
